Can you suggest some books written by Tony Hillerman?

gpt-4o-mini.title: The Tale Teller
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: A gripping mystery featuring the iconic protagonist, Joe Leaphorn, as he uncovers secrets in the Navajo Nation.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Skeleton Man (Joe Leaphorn/Jim Chee Novels)
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: In this gripping mystery by Tony Hillerman, Navajo detectives Joe Leaphorn and Jim Chee unravel a complex case involving ancient legends and modern crime, highlighting the rich cultural backdrop of the Southwest. The story delves into themes of tradition, identity, and the clash between the past and present.

gpt-4o-mini.title: Sacred Clowns
gpt-4o-mini.explanation: In Tony Hillerman's "Sacred Clowns," Navajo detectives Joe Leaphorn and Jim Chee navigate the complexities of cultural traditions and crime in the Southwest, unraveling a mystery that intertwines sacred rituals with modern-day challenges. This gripping tale highlights themes of identity and the clash between ancient customs and contemporary life.

gemma2:9b.title: The Blessing Way
gemma2:9b.explanation: First novel in the Leaphorn & Chee series, introducing Navajo Tribal Police officers.

gemma2:9b.title: The Wailing Wind
gemma2:9b.explanation: In "The Wailing Wind," Tony Hillerman weaves a gripping mystery set against the backdrop of the Navajo Nation, exploring themes of cultural heritage and justice as detectives Joe Leaphorn and Jim Chee investigate a murder tied to an ancient legend. Hillerman's rich storytelling and deep understanding of Native American traditions make this a compelling read for mystery enthusiasts.

gemma2:9b.title: The Ghostway
gemma2:9b.explanation: Leaphorn investigates a murder connected to ancient Navajo burial grounds.
